blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Newly-appointed chief justice Rodil Zalameda, 63, is a longtime public servant, having served as city prosecutor and associate justice of the Court of Appeals (CA) and the Supreme Court (SC). Under a scholarship grant, Zalameda obtained his law degree from the Ateneo de Manila University in 1987. As a law student, he was active in extracurricular activities, being part of the Ateneo Law Journal and Ateneo Law Bulletin. After passing the bar examination in 1988, he entered government work as a branch clerk of the Makati City Regional Trial Court (RTC). He had a brief stint in private […]...
